WITH current_record AS (
    SELECT id, submission_id, correlation_id, processing_status
    FROM lead_crm.lead_submissions
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.lead_submissions AS lead
    SET
        ai_confidence = $2::numeric,
        ai_extraction = $3::jsonb,
        processing_status = 'SCORING',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM current_record
    WHERE lead.id = current_record.id
      AND current_record.processing_status IN ('AI_PENDING', 'ANALYZING')
    RETURNING lead.id, lead.submission_id, lead.correlation_id,
              lead.processing_status, lead.ai_confidence, lead.ai_extraction
),
audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id, submission_id, event_type, actor_type,
        from_status, to_status, event_data
    )
    SELECT
        updated.correlation_id,
        updated.id,
        'AI_EXTRACTION_VALIDATED',
        'WORKFLOW',
        $6,
        'SCORING',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'model', 'qwen2.5:3b',
            'attempt', $4::integer,
            'schema_version', $3::jsonb->>'schema_version'
        )
    FROM updated
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    'AI_EXTRACTED' AS outcome,
    updated.submission_id,
    updated.id AS submission_record_id,
    updated.correlation_id,
    updated.processing_status,
    updated.ai_extraction,
    updated.ai_confidence,
    $4::integer AS ai_attempt,
    true AS should_continue,
    audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM updated
CROSS JOIN audit;

WITH current_record AS (
    SELECT id, submission_id, correlation_id, processing_status
    FROM lead_crm.lead_submissions
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.lead_submissions AS lead
    SET
        processing_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM current_record
    WHERE lead.id = current_record.id
      AND current_record.processing_status IN ('AI_PENDING', 'ANALYZING')
    RETURNING lead.id, lead.submission_id, lead.correlation_id,
              lead.processing_status
),
audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id, submission_id, event_type, actor_type,
        from_status, to_status, event_data
    )
    SELECT
        updated.correlation_id,
        updated.id,
        'AI_EXTRACTION_SCHEMA_FAILED',
        'WORKFLOW',
        $2,
        'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'model', 'qwen2.5:3b',
            'attempts', $4::integer,
            'validation_errors', $3::jsonb,
            'last_response', $5
        )
    FROM updated
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    'AI_REVIEW_REQUIRED' AS outcome,
    updated.submission_id,
    updated.id AS submission_record_id,
    updated.correlation_id,
    updated.processing_status,
    $3::jsonb AS ai_validation_errors,
    $4::integer AS ai_attempt,
    false AS should_continue,
    audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM updated
CROSS JOIN audit;
